messages:
anna-sdr: @devon-se / @lina-security — BlueBank asked for a short 2-week POC. They want least-privileged access, hosted API key if possible, but also asked about Dedicated pool trial and KMS-managed keys. Any blockers on issuing an ephemeral hosted key scoped to a single workspace? :wave:

devon-se: We can do ephemeral API keys scoped to a workspace. They expire after X hours and can be rotated. For Dedicated we'd need a reserved pool provisioned — takes ~3 business days. For POC we usually recommend hosted with ephemerals unless they require VPC.

lina-security: A few Qs: do they need BYOK/KMS for token encryption at rest, or just key-wrapping for signing? If they insist on HSM-backed KMS we need an enterprise private deploy path. @samir-eng FYI.

samir-eng: Quick notes:
- Hosted ephemeral keys: supported, scopes: read, generate, embeddings; no write/tenant admin by default.
- Example policy we give to customers:
```
roles:
  - name: poc_user
    permissions: ["inference:generate", "embeddings:read"]
  - name: poc_admin
    permissions: ["inference:generate", "embeddings:read", "workspace:invite"]
```
- BYOK/KMS: only available on Private deployments or Dedicated with enterprise add-on.

anna-sdr: Is there a template invite flow (least-privilege) we can hand to their infra team? Also any pricing delta for ephemeral keys vs standard hosted keys? They asked about cost predictability.

devon-se: Template exists — I can paste it. Pricing: hosted POC uses normal per-token billing; Dedicated trial can be offered as a time-limited credit or discounted commit. Ephemeral key itself doesn't change token pricing.

devon-se: Template invite (minimal):
```
1) Create workspace
2) Invite users with role poc_user
3) Generate ephemeral API key scoped to workspace & expiry=72h
4) Provide sample prompts and quota: 100k tokens/day
```

michael-ps: From sales/legal — they requested a short security questionnaire about access control and KMS. Lina, can we answer BYOK availability and where keys live? Also need a note about audit logs retention.

lina-security: BYOK = only on Private. For Hosted we can document encryption at rest and customer audit logs (access events) are available for 90 days by default; extensions via enterprise package. I'll draft answers and post in thread.

ops-bot: created dedicated-provision-request #REQ-7721 — estimated ETA 2024-11-04 if approved.

anna-sdr: Great. Action items:
- @devon-se: send invite template + ephemeral key instructions to customer (today)
- @lina-security: draft Qs answers on BYOK/audit retention (EOD)
- @samir-eng: confirm any technical blockers for workspace-scoped keys (ASAP)

samir-eng: No blockers from infra side. Need a small config change to enable "ephemeral_key" flag on the customer workspace — I'll schedule a quick deploy, should be <24h.

anna-sdr: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll update the customer and ask for their infra contact for the KMS question.
